description: Cancels a queued or running layout generation belonging to the specified board; use get_generation when only checking progress. A completed, failed or already cancelled job retains its terminal status. Cancellation cannot be undone; starting again requires a new job. It can update the saved board revision, so read get_board before further edits. A later job is unaffected. Guest access uses guestToken and excludes organization access.

boardId.description: Saved board ID from list_boards, create_board, claim_guest_board, or an account board URL. Must be accessible to the current account or guest session.

generationId.description: Layout generation ID returned by generate_layout for this same board. Use the exact job ID when polling or stopping it.

guestToken.description: Private guest-session capability returned by start_guest_session. Never print it or save it in a repository.

name: stop_generation
title: Stop generation
